name: security-audit
description: End-to-end security auditing for web, API, mobile, wireless, cloud, code, secrets, dependencies, IaC, containers and LLM apps. Token-optimised attack-surface triage, deterministic CVSS scoring, live CVE/KEV/EPSS/ATT&CK intelligence, an authorization gate for intrusive testing, and professional Markdown/HTML/SARIF reporting.

nvd_api_key.title: NVD API key
nvd_api_key.description: Optional. A free NIST NVD API key raises the CVE lookup rate limit from 5 to 50 requests per 30 seconds. Request one at https://nvd.nist.gov/developers/request-an-api-key

default_report_format.title: Default report formats
default_report_format.description: Comma-separated formats produced when you run the report skill without arguments (markdown, html, sarif, json, csv).

token_budget.title: Audit token budget
token_budget.description: Maximum tokens of source the attack-surface mapper may select for review in one pass. Lower is cheaper and shallower.

strict_authorization.title: Strict authorization gate
strict_authorization.description: When enabled, intrusive tooling is blocked unless .security-audit/scope.json authorizes the exact target. Disabling this is not recommended and never bypasses your own legal obligations.
